weather_report:
Tonight, Boston lies in a tranquil yet slightly cool embrace, draped in a shroud of clarity that offers a glimpse of the stars. The gentle northeast wind carries the soft whispers of the city as it settles into slumber, bringing with it a refreshing hint of anticipation for the day to come. As the moon softly glimmers in the sky, the temperature dips into the welcoming arms of the mid-fifties, prompting one to perhaps reach for a light sweater or a cozy shawl for that evening stroll beneath the twinkling skyline.

Looking ahead to Sunday, the promise of sunshine dances on the horizon, inviting all to engage with the day. With temperatures rising to a pleasantly warm forty-five degrees, the layers can be shed in favor of light and breathable fabrics. It appears to be a splendid day for a leisurely drive along the scenic routes or perhaps a visit to the local market, where the vibrant colors of fresh produce mirror the bright blue of the sky. A picnic in one of Boston's beautiful parks or a quiet reading session outdoors could also be perfect ways to savor the simple joys of life under the sun.
